a Provide free and compulsory education to all children till the age of 14 years
x: Constitution for regulating the training of rehabilitation professionals. The Rehabilitation Council of India Act, 1992 provides for regulating the training of rehabilitation professionals. The Council maintains a central register and sets standards for professionals working with persons with disabilities. This was a landmark step in institutionalising disability rehabilitation services in India.
